stops.note: Semtín, a district of Pardubice, + ex(plosive); the chemists Stanislav Brebera and Radim Fukátko developed it in the late 1950s, and production at Semtín began in 1964
Czechoslovakia exported tonnes to Libya, which passed much to the IRA; the 1988 Lockerbie bomb used it, and odour markers were added from the 1990s
